evals.name: pr-scoped-default
evals.prompt: Prepare a snapshot for codex of the current branch's changes.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs detect_repomix.sh, then handoff.sh --reviewer codex (XML, 160k budget). Output JSON has within_budget=true and a non-empty files_included list seeded from `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD`.

evals.name: path-scoped-gemini
evals.prompt: Bundle apps/web/src/components/chat for gemini so they can review the chat composer.
evals.expected_output: handoff.sh runs with --paths apps/web/src/components/chat --reviewer gemini. Style markdown, max_tokens 1000000. No trimming required given gemini's huge budget. Output file ends in .md.

evals.name: over-budget-triggers-trim
evals.prompt: Pack the whole apps/web tree for kimi at 50k tokens — must trim docs and configs first.
evals.expected_output: handoff.sh runs --paths apps/web --reviewer kimi --max-tokens 50000. Trim loop drops *.md, *.json, *.css, etc. before any .ts source. Summary JSON shows files_trimmed populated and within_budget=true, OR within_budget=false with a clear warning when source-only remains over budget.

evals.name: repomix-missing-graceful
evals.prompt: Prepare a snapshot for review (in an environment where repomix is not installed).
evals.expected_output: detect_repomix.sh returns available=false. handoff.sh exits with a non-zero status and prints an actionable install message (`npm i -g repomix`). Skill does NOT silently continue or fabricate a snapshot.

evals.name: cross-review-integration
evals.prompt: Cross-review this branch with codex, but the diff is huge — give codex enough context to actually review.
evals.expected_output: Skill first runs handoff.sh --reviewer codex --expand-imports to produce a context-rich snapshot, then suggests piping its --output path to the cross-review skill (without modifying cross-review scripts). Documents the integration in chat.
